In this episode, I speak with Jeffrey Baird, managing partner at Merritt Point Partners. Merritt Point Partners seeks to build diversified portfolios of convexity exposure through the commodities market.

key_points.text: we talk about what makes the commodities market unique, who the players are, and the types of trades that Jeff looks for.
